nodes.name: Marker Eleven
nodes.brief: Halloran has a splice crew waiting below marker eleven. Kestrel locked the shed and posted a track guard. Clear the right-of-way without touching the conduit; the crew will do the work after dusk.

nodes.name: Cold Contact
nodes.brief: A Halloran plate camera caught Kestrel moving one bone-white machine with no shop stamp, hatch seam or exhaust. Bring the escort down and hold the ground. Halloran waives its claim on whatever comes off the white hull.

nodes.name: Relay Station
nodes.brief: Halloran Freight wants their relay back intact. Take the compound and hold it long enough for their engineers to walk in.

nodes.name: Depot Road
nodes.brief: The cut conduit exposed an Aurelian service address in the fault traffic. Kestrel has the same address and a rearguard on the ridge. Hold the survey key long enough to resolve the depot approach.

nodes.name: The Causeway
nodes.brief: Halloran wants the drowned valley crossing open before the rains close the fords. One raised road, one garrison, and a hardstand at mid-span that decides which of you owns the other bank.

nodes.name: Broken Rule
nodes.brief: A Sarn yard camera recorded a Kestrel machine following an ejection seat with its guns. Kestrel came back for the recording and locked the outer works. Sarn wants the detachment removed and the camera left standing.

nodes.name: The Dark Towns
nodes.brief: Kestrel cutters opened the western conduit and six Ridgeward towns went dark. The east breaker can carry the pumps if it stays in Assembly hands for ninety seconds. Hold the terrace while the load transfers.

nodes.name: Burn the Depot
nodes.brief: Halloran's contract gets the company through the doors. What happens behind them is your account. Arm the purge train, clear Kestrel's guard, and leave no sealed stock for the next employer to own.

nodes.name: Take the Depot
nodes.brief: Halloran's contract gets the company through the doors. What happens behind them is your account. Take the command key intact, clear Kestrel's guard, and put the depot manifest under your own seal.
